Class PlannerModel

java.lang.Object
mvc.AbstractModel
planner.model.PlannerModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Model
public class PlannerModel extends AbstractModel
The main model for the student planner application. Manages students, courses, and tasks using the MVC framework.
